name: app-dark-green-glow-glass-jtbd-and-journey-map-panels
title: Glass Jobs-to-Be-Done and Journey Map Panels
whatItIs: Two dark rounded panels with a lime-green glow rising from the base: at left a Jobs To Be Done heading with tilted frosted glass cards stating user needs, and at right a CJM heading with a tilted glass table of Stage, Goal and User Action rows, each with a short paragraph with phrases in brighter white.
whatItMeans: Tilting glass cards and tables in 3D makes text-heavy research feel like an object, and the green glow adds atmosphere to a dark slide.
techniques: Green glow rising from the bottom corner
Bright key phrases inside a grey paragraph
Table rendered as a floating tilted sheet
Two equal dark panels side by side
bestFor: Text content presented as glass objects

vocabulary.definition: A framework describing what users want to achieve in a situation.
A table of stages, goals and actions over a user's experience.
